name: gen3-map-blueprint
description: Procedural map blueprint generator and editor for a pokeemerald ROM hack. Runs locally in the browser.

scripts.build:standalone: vite build --mode standalone && node scripts/postbuild.mjs standalone
scripts.build:web: vite build --mode web && node scripts/postbuild.mjs web
scripts.build: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:web
